query Query($where: WorkOrderWhereInput, $orderBy: [WorkOrderOrderByInput!], $first: Int, $after: String) {
  wo: workOrder(where: $where, orderBy: $orderBy, first: $first, after: $after) {
    edges {
      node {
        id
        workOrderStatusId
        quantity
        strategy: productStrategy {
          active
          code
          validated
          externalId
          customData
          product {
            id
            code
            active
          }
          strategyTypeId
          facilityId
          processes: strategyProcesses {
            edges {
              node {
                id
                code
                standardPositions
                cycleTime
                distributionPercentage
                idealRate
                leadTime
                minimumProductionRunTime
                percentToStart
                productionOffalAllowed
                productionOperators
                quantityToStart
                quotedRate
                setupOffalAllowed
                setupOperators
                setupRate
                standardRate
                timeToStart
                transitTimeAfter
                transitTimeBefore
                unitPerCycle
                unitWeight
                active
                allowMixedLots
                autoTriggerDependency
                defaultDistribution
                final
                finishedGood
                generatePurchaseOrder
                rawMaterial
                requireReceipt
                transferSerial
                useSupplierLabel
                useWorkcenterRates
                wip
                description
                externalId
                order
                customData
                integrationData
                processId
                productStrategyId
                productionTypeId
                controlPanelId
                documentDesignId
                lotControlId
                putAwayLocationId
                schedulingGroupId
                weightUnitId
                workcenterId
                boms: assemblyBoms {
                  edges {
                    node {
                      id
                      order
                      fixedLaborUsage
                      fixedMachineUsage
                      fixedMaterialUsage
                      laborUsage
                      machineUsage
                      maximumUsage
                      minimumUsage
                      rate
                      standardPackQuantity
                      standardUsage
                      unitPerCycle
                      active
                      defaultPackaging
                      externalId
                      reference
                      customData
                      integrationData
                      assemblyProductStrategyProcessId
                      bomTypeId
                      assetId
                      componentPackagingMaterialId
                      componentProductId
                      componentProductStrategyId
                      componentProductStrategyProcessId
                      consumptionModeId
                    }
                  }
                }
                assets: productStrategyProcessAssets {
                  edges {
                    node {
                      id
                      active
                      description
                      order
                      customData
                      assetDesignId
                      assetGroupDesignId
                    }
                  }
                }
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
